    Help & Support

    How to use the App:

    1. Select your Course from the side menu.

    2. Select the Semester you want to study.

    3. Use the tabs (PDF, Audio, Video, Q-Bank, Quiz) to browse materials.

    Troubleshooting:

    • If a video or audio stream doesn't play automatically, wait a few seconds for the Google Drive stream fallback.

    • If you get logged out, it means your session expired (7 days) or you logged in from another device.

    Contact Support:

    For queries or password resets, contact the administration at Marvellous Education.
